chapter.verse: Tua khit ciangin Topa in a dang sawmsagihte koih a, a pai nading khuapi, khuaneu tengah ama mai-ah nih tek, nih tekin a sawl hi.
Tuate kiangah thu a piakna in, “Buh at ding tampi om hi. Ahih hangin a at ding mite tawm hi. Tua ahih ciangin buh-at nasem ding hong sawl in ci-in, buh nei Topa kiangah thu na ngen un.
Pai un. Ngia hon lakah tuuno kikhahte bangin no kong sawl hi.
Dangka-ip, thung-ip, khedap, tuate na keng kei un. Lampi ah na pai lai takun kuamah na hopih kei un.
Inn khatpeuh mah na lut uh ciangin, ‘Hih inn sungah thupha om ta hen,’ ci-in a masa-in na gen un.
Tua innah thupha deih mi a om leh, note thupha a tungah a tung ding hi. A om kei leh, note kiangah hong kileh kik ding hi.
Tua innah na om uh ciangin an ne tui dawnin, amau hong piak uh bangin na ne un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nasempa in thaman ngah ding kilawm hi. Inn khat panin inn khatah kawm themthum kei un.
Khua khatpeuh mah na lut uh ciangin, khua mite in hong tun’sak uh leh, note mai-ah hong lui khempeuh na ne un.
Cinate na damsak un. ‘Pasian’ Gam in note kiangah hong nai zo hi,’ ci-in thu na hilh un.
Khua khatpeuh mah na lut uh ciangin, khua mite in no hong nolh leh, tua khua lampi ah na paikhia un la,
‘Ka khepeek uh ah hong belh no khua leivui nangawn note langkhat ah ka nulkhia uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian’ Gam hong nai zo hi ci-in na thei ta un,’ ci-in na gen un.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, tua Ni ciangin tua khua in Sodom khua sangin gimna a thuak zaw ding hi.”

“Khorazin khuapi aw, nangmah in gimna na thuak ding hi. Bethsaida khuapi aw, nangmah in gimna na thuak ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note sungah hong kilak vangliatna in Tai-ar khuapi leh Sidon khuapi sungah kilak ngei hi leh, amau in sawtpekin khautang puan silhin, vut tawh kibuakin a kisik kik zo ding uh hi.
Thukhen ni ciangin note in Tai-ar leh Sidon khuapi sangin gimna na thuak zaw ding uh hi.
Nang Kapernaum khuapi aw, vantung khua dongin minthan’na na ngah ding hiam? Nang in hel khua dongin na kiasuk ding hi.
Note thu a ngaite in ka thu a ngai hi. Note hong nolhte in kei zong hong nolh hi. Kei hong nolhte in kei hong sawlpa zong a nolh hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
Tua sawmsagihte in lungdamna tawh hong ciahkik uh a, “Topa aw, na minin dawite nangawn ka zo uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Satan in khuaphia bangin vantung pan hong kiasuk ke’n ka mu zo hi.
En un, note in gul gilote leh aikamte na sikgawp nading uh leh na galte’ vangliatna khempeuh na zawh nadingun thu ke’n kong pia hi.
Note bangmah in hong bawlsia kei ding hi. Ahih hangin dawite na zawh uh hangin lungdam kei un. Vantung khua sungah na min uh a kigelh manin na lungdam ta un,” a ci hi.

Tua lai takin Zeisu in Kha Siangtho tawh lungdam a, “Vantung leh leitung a uk ka Pa aw, nangmah in hih thute mipilte leh misiamte kiangah im-inah, naupangte tungah lak na hih ciangin, na hehpihna ka phat hi. Ahi mah hi ka Pa aw, tua bangin na deih hi.
Ka Pa in na khempeuh kei hong pia zo hi. Pa longal kuamah in Tapa a thei kei hi. Tapa mahmah leh Tapa in a theihsak nopte longal kuamah in Pa a thei kei hi.” a ci hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite lamah kihei a, “No na muh nate a mu mittangte in thupha a ngah ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na muhte uh Pasian’ kamsang tampite leh kumpi tampite in a muh nop uh hangin a mu kei uh hi. Na zakte uh a zak nop uh hangin a za kei uh hi ci-in kong gen hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Thukham siapa khat ding-in Zeisu ze-et a, “Sia aw, tawntung nuntakna luah nadingin bang ka hih ding hiam? ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Thukhamna sungah bang a kigelh hiam? Bangci na sim hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin,
amah in, “Na Topa Pasian, na lungsim khempeuh, na kha khempeuh, na thahatna khempeuh, na pilna khempeuh tawh na it in. Na pumpi na it bangin na lawmte na it in,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Na dawn’na thu ahi takpi hi. Tua bangin na hih leh, na nungta ding hi.” a ci hi.
Tua pa in ama phatna thu a lah nop manin, “Ka lawmte kuate ahi hiam?” ci-in Zeisu a dong hi.

Zeisu in zong, “Mi khat in Jerusalem khua panin Jerikho khua-ah a paisuk lai takin, misuamte tawh kituak hi. Misuamte in tua pa’ puan hawkkhia a, nakpi-in a sat khit uh ciangin, si dek takin a nusia uh hi.
Tua lampi ah siampi khat paikha zenzen a, tua pa a muh ciangin peelin a nusia hi.
Tua mah bangin Levi mi khat hong tung a, tua pa a muh ciangin peelin a pai leuleu hi.
Ahih hangin Samaria mi khat in khualzinin a pai lai takin ama omna hong tung a;
a muh ciangin hehpihhuai sa a, va nai-in ama liammate sathau leh leenggahtui nuh a, puan tawh a gak khit ciangin ama la tungah tuangsakin, zintun’na innah paipihin a khoi hi.
Zingsang a paikhiat ciangin peek nih la a, zintun’ inn ukpa a piak khit ciangin, “Hih mi na khoi in, a bei khempeuh kong paikik ciangin kong loh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Nang bangci ngaihsut na hi hiam? Tua mi thum sung panin kua pen in misuamte tawh a kituakpa’ lawm ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Thukham siapa in, “Tua a hehpihpa in a lawmpa ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Zeisu in, “Nang zong pai in la, tua mah bangin na hih in,” a ci hi.
Amaute lampi ah a pai lai takun, khua khatah lut uh a, Martha kici numei khat in ama innah a tungsak hi.
Tua numei in Mari a kici sanggam numei khat a nei hi. Tua Mari in Zeisu khe kiangah tu-in ama thu a ngai hi.

Ahih hangin Martha ahih leh, an bawlin gim a, Zeisu kiangah va nai-in, “Topa aw, kei bek in an bawlin ka nau in hong huh loh ding na awi hiam? Amah in kei hong huh nading thu pia in,” ci-in a ngen hi.
Zeisu in, “Martha aw, Martha aw, nang in na tampi na lunghimawh a, gimna na thuak hi.
Ahih hangin sapna khat bek a om hi. Mari in ahih leh, na hoih khat a teel zo hi. Tua na in ama tung pan kilakhia lo ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
